headline: Owner gets the live-reps memo and a decision (PR #184): more setups live is the only lever that scales, paired with a two-stage promotion rule; the main session's GAP-U switch fails a fair re-test.
bullets: DECISION PROMO2: score On Deck only on sessions after the move and show K on every promotion suggestion - zero-edge passes ~11% -> ~1%, at the cost of real edges needing ~40 sessions.
Reps memo: a session is worth ~5 independent trades; new setup-days speed verdicts, more same-day trades don't; no verdict rule beats the base rate yet.
GAP-U (REGSW's only survivor) fails with a shared-day random baseline; REGSW-2 on a winning base 0 of 4; coil switch closed in two shapes.
FAMC forward session 1: 2 events, +0.61R vs control - one session, no reading.
Calibrated replay (FWDCAL) result still to come tonight.
next: FWDCAL rule-21 result; softer second-stage simulation; REGSW-2 ex-market check; FAMC nightly.
